evals.prompt: Hey, I've got this CSV of our online orders from last year. Can you give me a summary of what's going on? The file is excel-report-workspace/test-data/ecommerce_orders.csv
evals.expected_output: A structured markdown report with Executive Summary, Data Overview, Key Findings, and Recommendations. Saved to output/reports/ecommerce_orders-report.md

assertions.text: Report markdown file exists in the outputs directory
Report contains an 'Executive Summary' section heading
Report contains a 'Key Findings' section heading
Report contains a 'Recommendations' section heading
Report cites specific numeric values (e.g., mean, count, dollar amounts)
Report correctly states the dataset has 200 rows
Report flags high-value outlier orders (values around $900+)
Report mentions at least 3 of the 5 product categories

evals.prompt: My HR team exported this employee survey data and I need to present findings to leadership. Can you break down excel-report-workspace/test-data/employee_survey.csv and flag anything I should be aware of?
evals.expected_output: A structured markdown report flagging missing values and salary outliers. Saved to output/reports/employee_survey-report.md

assertions.text: Report markdown file exists in the outputs directory
Report contains an 'Executive Summary' section heading
Report contains a 'Key Findings' section heading
Report contains a 'Recommendations' section heading
Report cites specific numeric values (e.g., mean salary, percentages)
Report correctly states the dataset has 150 rows
Report flags missing values in SatisfactionRating or LastReviewScore columns
Report flags salary outliers ($180k+ values)

evals.prompt: Summarize this sensor log for me: excel-report-workspace/test-data/sensor_readings.csv
evals.expected_output: A structured markdown report with stats on temperature, humidity, pressure. Saved to output/reports/sensor_readings-report.md

assertions.text: Report markdown file exists in the outputs directory
Report contains an 'Executive Summary' section heading
Report contains a 'Key Findings' section heading
Report contains a 'Recommendations' section heading
Report cites specific numeric values (e.g., temperature mean, pressure range)
Report correctly states the dataset has 50 rows
Report mentions all three metrics: temperature, humidity, and pressure
Report references sensor IDs (S-01, S-02, or S-03)
